title: A Podcast About the Tuition Fee Nobody Could Explain
script: Host: [warmly] Tonight's guest is Arman, a university administrator with an unusual story about a tuition payment. Welcome, Arman.
Guest: [pleasantly] Thanks for having me. This story genuinely surprised our whole finance office when it happened.
Host: [curious] Set the scene for us. What exactly happened?
Guest: [thoughtful] A struggling student was one week away from being withdrawn for unpaid fees, despite having excellent grades throughout the semester.
Guest: [reflective] Then, seemingly out of nowhere, her entire remaining balance was paid in cash, in person, by someone our staff didn't recognize at all.
Host: [interested] Did that person leave any information behind, a name, a note, anything at all?
Guest: [honestly] Nothing. He simply said the payment was for her account, insisted on no receipt with his name, and left before anyone could ask further questions.
Host: [surprised] How did the student react when she found out?
Guest: [warmly] She came into our office in tears, asking desperately who had paid it, because she wanted to thank them properly, even just once.
Host: [thoughtful] Could you tell her anything useful?
Guest: [gently] Only that he was an older man, calm, and that he asked our cashier not to make a scene about it whatsoever.
Host: [curious] Do you have any theory about who he might have been?
Guest: [reflective] We suspect he may have overheard her talking with a friend in the hallway about being withdrawn, although we can't confirm that at all.
Host: [thoughtful] What strikes you most about this story, even now?
Guest: [sincere] That in spite of having every opportunity to be thanked publicly, he clearly chose not to be, on purpose, deliberately.
Host: [reflective] It makes you wonder how often that happens quietly, without anyone in a story like this ever finding out.
Guest: [warmly] Exactly. We assume most tuition problems get solved through scholarships or loans, yet apparently some get solved by strangers who want nothing in return.
Host: [thoughtful] Has the student managed to stay enrolled since then?
Guest: [smiling] She has, and she's graduating this year, still hoping that one day, somehow, she'll manage to properly thank him.
